Post Date: 2016-09-11T03:38:22Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Set max SSL fragment size in Express
Description: I'm using express to set up an HTTPS server for some embedded devices. However, due to the lack of computing capabilities, the default SSL fragment size 16384 is too large for these devices. I wonder how I can change this size in express.
I found that in tls modules, TLSSocket class has a method _tlsSocket.setMaxSendFragment(size)_ which may work, but I can't find out how to use it in Express.
This is how my server is established:

```

```
